subject.title: refactor: move MCP OAuth state to SQLite

question: Do maintainers accept the immediate Doctor-only cutover, where runtime never reads legacy MCP OAuth credentials and existing sessions remain unavailable until migration succeeds?
rationale: The patch deliberately trades automatic credential continuity for one canonical owner, resurrection prevention, and fail-closed migration; tests cannot choose that security and release policy.

options.title: Accept Doctor-only cutover
options.body: Ship the single-store boundary with explicit upgrade guidance and no runtime compatibility path after current-head proof and dependency review complete.

options.title: Require staged compatibility
options.body: Pause and define a time-bounded explicit compatibility mode with a removal plan before changing the runtime owner.

recommendation.title: Accept Doctor-only cutover
recommendation.body: Ship the single-store boundary with explicit upgrade guidance and no runtime compatibility path after current-head proof and dependency review complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion names this security owner for the exact accept-or-reject decision.
